args: Authorize ONLY the remaining observation-producing free-air approach from the actual current pose to hover_target with the supplied orientation and own finger envelope. The target is 105 mm above the newly measured package top, higher than the old 75 mm target, to keep more top texture visible. Is this remaining swept route visibly free of bottle, bowl, stove and cabinet with at least 10 mm separation? Confirm the same package remains on the table and the gripper is visibly empty. Do not infer hidden clearance. A rejected tracker is diagnostic only: direct current distributed depth/boundary measurements, not that transform, define this high approach. No descent to contact or closure is authorized.

geometry.assumptions: Same visible flat package on a locally horizontal table. Boundary rays intersect a validated horizontal top approximation. Surface allowance is an engineering reserve, not calibrated accuracy; no hidden bottom or side is reconstructed.

result.explanation: Authorize only the remaining open-gripper, observation-producing approach from the current pose to hover_target with the supplied orientation and finger envelope. Both current views support at least 10 mm separation from the visible bottle, bowl, stove and cabinet along this high sweep. The bowl and stove are below it; the bottle is initially below and then laterally away from it; the cabinet is well outside it. The final finger-envelope minimum height is about 1.014 m, not the package top. The labeled cream-cheese package remains flat on the table, and the open fingers visibly hold nothing. Current distributed surface and boundary evidence supports this assessment; the rejected tracker is not used. Regions supply visible obstacle geometry, not hidden surfaces or a global clearance certificate. No contact descent, closure or placement is authorized.
